what: While the panel (default 300svh) stays fixed on screen, several photos dissolve one after another in step with scrolling. The next image bleeds in along noise (fbm, size 2.4) contours (edge ±.15), the two images distort in opposite directions (strength .55 × .5), and midway through the change the colors split into red and blue (sin(progress·π) × .35 × .03). Even when still, the screen drifts slightly (.4 × .008, breathing .4 × .02), and the edges darken by .28 toward the cover color

options.split: Color splitting, default .35 — at 0 it does not split
options.drift: Drift while idle, default .4 — 0 means it stays still
options.shade: Edge cover color skin variable name, default --kf-ink
options.--fx-length: Panel height (css variable), default 300svh — increase it when there are many sections
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Image to swap (an img or a cell containing an img). If there is no image, use a placeholder panel that draws data-label

use: — ogl loads library/_vendor/ogl@1.0.11/ogl.min.js first (global OGL)

from.where: studio.html exhibition photo section (.st-morph) — original studio-morph-section (OGL · melt · strength .55 · size 2.4 · chromatic aberration .35 · drift .4 · overlay #0f0f0e .28 · 300svh fixed)

note: The original slider also has drag, auto advance, ripple, horizontal shear and swirl types, but this site only uses the scroll-bound melt, and the part builds only that. With reduced motion, slides cross-fade without distortion, splitting or drifting
